newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-IRWIN BIRDIES 18TH TO WIN LAS VEGAS SENIOR CLASSIC.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-IRWIN BIRDIES 18TH TO WIN LAS VEGAS SENIOR CLASSIC.

text.p: Hale Irwin, who squandered a three-shot lead in a span of nine holes, recovered to win the $1 million Las Vegas Senior Classic on Sunday when he rolled in a 14-foot birdie putt on the last hole.

Irwin, who won for the fourth time this year, shot a one-over-par 72 and finished at six-under 207, one stroke better than Isao Aoki and four ahead of two-time defending champion Jim Colbert and John Jacobs.

Irwin took home $150,000 and leads the Senior Tour money list with $746,531. Last week, he captured the second major event on the Senior Tour -- the PGA Seniors' Championship -- by a whopping 12 strokes over Jack Nicklaus and Dale Douglass.
The second-place finish was Aoki's second of the month and his fourth top-three finish this year.
